title: Koppenteller: wie staat er in de kop (open data)
description: Open data behind koppenteller.nl: one row per headline and one row per person in 21,574 headlines from fifteen Dutch news outlets, January 2025 to November 2026. Read by a language model following a fixed handbook; a check by people is under way (pilot). Methods: https://koppenteller.nl/en/methods
